findings.claim: The four remediated OPS contracts publish 64 paths with a doubled slash (FIELD 26, EVIDENCE 14, OFFLINE-SYNC 14, SNAPSHOTS 10), for example /v1/ops/field//agent-profiles, because api.basePath omits the trailing slash while api.resources[].path keeps a leading one and tools/contracts/generate-openapi.mjs line 84 joins them literally instead of using joinRoute from tools/blueprints/route.mjs; the generated controllers mount v1/ops/field/agent-profiles, so not one published OPS path matches runtime. contracts:check cannot see it because it compares the generator to its own output, and teat-route-contract.md section 1 item 3 orders exactly this concatenation defect corrected before any client is generated. BP-OPS-AGENCY-001 and every INF and CH contract are clean, so previous high 5 is closed for AGENCY only.
findings.fix: Adopt the BP-OPS-AGENCY-001 and BP-INF-AIT-001 convention in the four blueprints (basePath ending in a slash, resource paths without a leading slash) or make generate-openapi.mjs join through joinRoute; then regenerate the five contracts and re-run contracts:check.

findings.claim: The four blueprints omit api.resources[].resource on all 32 entries (FIELD 13, EVIDENCE 7, OFFLINE-SYNC 7, SNAPSHOTS 5), so generate-openapi.mjs line 101 reads undefined and every operation in the four published contracts carries tags with a single null element (see BP-OPS-FIELD-001.openapi.json line 13), which is not a valid OpenAPI tag and drops the ops resource identity that teat-route-contract.md section 1 item 4 requires in the published contract. BP-OPS-AGENCY-001 declares the field and emits agency-unit, agency-jurisdiction and agency-competence correctly.
findings.fix: Declare explicit resource identifiers for the 32 OPS resources in the four blueprints and regenerate the contracts.

findings.claim: Four generated identifiers diverge from the closed route contract: path ait-numbering-ranges and controller resource ops:ait-numbering-range against numbering-ranges and numbering-range in section 4.3; sync-receipts against receipts in the same table; and agent-profiles and operational-devices against agents and devices in section 4.2. WP-T2 wires policy against these keys, and teat-route-contract.md still names the retired ops-operations and ops-evidence-custody packages in section 2.
findings.fix: Align the four names with teat-route-contract.md sections 4.2 and 4.3, or record the rename and amend that contract in the same PR.
